Gossifleur

Grass

Galar · Generation 8

Gossifleur is a Grass-type Flowering Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 2.2 kg. It evolves into Eldegoss. Its highest base stat is Defense (60), with a base stat total of 250.
